answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the river queue naming the meadow that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 8 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, every alias costs 8 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the oasis record publishes exactly who is still on probation. That is 36 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
